MergesSurfaceTests.The_sort_button_carri.reason: Library and desktop Merges use the same compact SortMenu component. Its name carries the selected order, each radio row closes the menu and restores focus, and native tests measure the original row/dot/inset geometry at 80%, 100% and 140% zoom. Keyboard navigation, typeahead, one-layer Escape, outside dismissal and real Library ordering are verified. Fullscreen retains its independent sort sheets.

MergesSurfaceTests.Every_user_facing_str.reason: Static queue markup text, labels, tooltips and placeholders bind to the copy module; section, sort and platform options are centralized there too. The AST guard rejects literal JSX text and literal user-facing attributes. As in the original XAML guard, dynamic bindings are allowed; model and fact sentences retain their separate behavioral tests.

MergesSurfaceTests.The_rail_row_binds_it.reason: The dedicated desktop rail destination retains its plain label and original explanatory tooltip, contains no count and computes to full opacity. Empty-queue application coverage preserves that identity; native routing checks Details return focus and Escape back to Library. Fullscreen retains its separate Library-tools path.

MergesSurfaceTests.The_merge_queue_answe.reason: Desktop owns Up/Down, Space, S/Enter and D only while the queue or a member has focus. The host owns Escape back to Library. Home/End and unrelated keys remain unhandled, modified shortcuts never write decisions and focused input controls keep their keys. Fullscreen sheet-local Home/End navigation is independent.

MergesSurfaceTests.Each_key_does_the_one.reason: Up/Down clamps the row cursor, Space promotes without writing, S and Enter dispatch exactly one link using the current parent, and D dispatches exactly one dismissal for that card. Handled answers suppress default activation. Real Escape navigates once without changing candidates or history.

MergesSurfaceTests.The_row_template_take.reason: Real row-body pointer promotion, keyboard focus and cursor movement preserve independent Details and inclusion targets; hover swaps the reason. The main-row state follows promotion, while expansion bases remain fixed. React uses a named focusable row-title button inside the row instead of an Avalonia focusable Border.

MergesSurfaceTests.Every_answer_on_the_c.reason: Desktop and fullscreen assert exact source-equivalent names, visible labels and tooltips for Same game, Different games and Separate again. Names track included members and header changes, and the named controls dispatch one group act and one Undo.

MergesSurfaceTests.The_dock_binds_the_qu.reason: Both surfaces expose the queue's saved title and note, exactly one Undo and one Dismiss button, original tooltips and one matching Undo write.

MergesSurfaceTests.The_toolbar_and_chip_.reason: This assertion checks five named Avalonia XAML selectors in controls.axaml and prohibits StaticResource because of Avalonia's parse-time resource ordering. Electron has no XAML resource parser or those selectors. Behavioral sort, kind and theme contracts are tracked separately; this classification does not waive their appearance or interaction.

MergesSurfaceTests.No_view_defines_the_s.reason: The source guard prohibits redeclaring five specific controls.axaml Style selectors in three Avalonia views. Electron components import shared CSS instead of declaring Avalonia Styles. The exact selector ownership assertion has no surviving mechanism; rendered control behavior is covered separately.

MergesSurfaceTests.Every_member_the_rewr.reason: This reflection/source guard requires seven retired CLR view-model types, twelve retired CLR members and four obsolete XAML binding names to remain absent after an earlier Avalonia rewrite. None participates in the Electron renderer. It does not assert current grouping or history behavior, which remains under behavioral migration tests.
